_comment: GitHub App manifest for the dedicated merge reviewer (FUL-37). Used with the App-manifest creation flow (see ops/PROVISION-REVIEWER.md). Permissions are the MINIMUM required to submit pull-request reviews and evaluate policy. No webhook, no write beyond pull_requests, single-repo install.
name: ffr-merge-reviewer
description: Second-party automated PR reviewer for fullstackforge-baileys-sidecar. Approves routine PRs on a green baileys-sidecar-gate so required_approving_review_count=1 can be enforced without a self-approval deadlock (FUL-37).
